messages:
Alex Chen: Hey everyone — first day! I'm Alex, joining as Product/Design (focused on onboarding flows). Quick wins I need today: Figma access, the public product roadmap, and where research notes live. Any shortcuts?
Marisol (Design Lead): Welcome Alex :tada: Which email did you sign up with? I'll invite you to the Design org and the Product files. Also we'll pair on the roadmap later.
Alex Chen: alex.chen@redwood.com — thanks! Also curious about our research process: do we use Dovetail, Notion, something else for notes + highlights?
Kate_IT: Okta/SSO should be provisioned already but if you don't see Figma invite check spam. If needed run: ``https://okta.redwood.com/signin`` then hit "Request App Access" > Figma. Ping me if it stalls.
Marisol (Design Lead): Invite sent to alex.chen@redwood.com — you should get a Figma email in a few mins. I added you to the "Design — Product" team. The high-level project folder is: https://www.figma.com/team/redwood-design/project/product (ask if link blocked).
Reese (Research): We store raw transcripts + highlights in Dovetail and our synthesis docs in Notion under Research > Observation Library. Shortcuts: the Notion page is /Research/Observation Library and we have a template called "Interview synthesis — 30m". For recruiting/scheduling use research@redwood.com Calendly.
Jamie_PM: Roadmap lives in Notion too: Product > Roadmap (6m view). For specs check the "Product Spec" DB (filters by squad). @Alex, if you want I can walk you through the quarter plan Fri 11am for 30m.
Alex Chen: That'd be great, thanks @Jamie_PM. One more: where do designers look for past usability tests?
Reese (Research): Past tests are bundled in Dovetail projects named by feature (search by feature slug). We also copy key takeaways into Notion cards (tagged with #usability). Policy: always add a 1-paragraph TL;DR to the Notion doc.
Kate_IT: If Figma invite didn't arrive — try this CLI-ish flow (internal):
```
# request app access via internal tool
curl -X POST https://infra.redwood.com/apps/request -d '{"app":"figma","user":"alex.chen@redwood.com"}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <your-token>"
```
Marisol (Design Lead): Quick onboarding checklist for you: 1) confirm Figma invite, 2) join #design-review and #product-ops, 3) read: Product Roadmap + Onboarding Brief (Notion), 4) schedule quick intro with me and Jamie.
devex-bot: Automated: added Alex Chen to "Design — Product" Figma team (pending acceptance).
Alex Chen: Got the Figma invite and joined the team. Thanks everyone! I'll read the roadmap doc now and book the Friday sync. Also happy to pair on research triage if anyone wants a hand. :raised_hands:
Marisol (Design Lead): Awesome — welcome again. I'll DM you a short list of files to skim first (homepage flows, signup, onboarding flows).
